meta.name: paid-ads-amazon
meta.description: Plan and review Amazon Ads with margin-aware ACoS, product, and search-term guardrails. Use for Amazon advertising, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, ASIN targeting, Amazon ACoS, or Amazon Ads performance exports.

copy.tagline: 结合利润率规划并审查亚马逊广告,守住ACoS与投放边界。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在亚马逊投放广告,需要同时优化利润与广告花费。
copy.tagline_en: Plan and review Amazon Ads with margin-aware ACoS and campaign guardrails.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Amazon ads and need to balance margin and ad spending.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先读取两套共享规则，再帮你规划或审查亚马逊广告：记录产品、毛利、目标ACoS等数据，提出最小测试计划，并报告ACoS、转化率、搜索词质量等指标，标记待确认状态。
howto.when: 当你说要规划或审查亚马逊广告，涉及 Sponsored Products 等广告类型、ACoS 分析或广告表现导出时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划这个ASIN的亚马逊广告，目标ACoS设25%。
say.note: Claude会先收集产品毛利等数据再出计划。

say.text: 审查这份亚马逊广告导出，报告ACoS和转化率。
say.note: 它会给出指标并标注数据延迟。

say.text: 为这条产品线制定自动发现广告测试，预算每天50美元。
say.note: 它会提出最小学习计划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads shared rules, then plans/reviews Amazon Ads: records product, margin, target ACoS, proposes a minimal test plan, and reports ACoS, conversion, search-term quality, marking status as ready_for_review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan or review Amazon Ads, involving ad types like Sponsored Products, ACoS analysis, or performance export.

say_en.text: Plan Amazon Ads for this ASIN with target ACoS of 25%.
say_en.note: Claude will first gather product margin data.

say_en.text: Review this Amazon Ads export and report ACoS and conversion rate.
say_en.note: It will report metrics and data lag.

say_en.text: Create an auto-discovery campaign test for this product line, budget $50/day.
say_en.note: It will propose a minimal learning plan.
